title: 18233 - 18233/P1825
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
commonCauses: Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri from/to Pressure Control Valve 3 (N217) Artı (12V) Kutba Kısa Devre
stepByStepSolution: Kontrol edin:  Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri from/to Pressure Control Valve 3 (N217)
technicalNotes:
Pressure Control Valve 3 (N217) might be referred to as Solenoid Valve 6 (N93)
Start with checking connectors for corrosion or water damage, in case of 01V transmission pay special attention to 16-pin connector between valve body and wiring harness.
model: 911, Passat, Golf, Tiguan, Polo, Arteon, Touareg, Transporter, Caddy, Amarok, Scirocco, Jetta, A3, A4, A5, A6, A7, A8, Q3, Q5, Q7, Q8, TT, Leon, Ibiza, Ateca, Arona, Tarraco, Octavia, Superb, Kodiaq, Karoq, Fabia, Scala, Cayenne, Macan, Panamera, Taycan
